Her performance indicates a need for more independent critical thinking and a deeper conceptual grasp beyond mere implementation.

**Key Strengths:**

    *   Siddharth explicitly stated that "caching, embeddings, how to, you know, save on embedding costs at scale. Those will be, these buttons will haunt you forever. As long as you are an AI engineer, in every interview they will ask you, okay? And it is so important to... Name the fundamentals here." [22 July 2026, 3-4 — Siddharth Saminathan], indicating the importance of this area where Himaya shows strength.

    *   He emphasized the importance of independent thought: "If you take three days and you think something and you come up with something on your own, even if it doesn't work, I'll be happy. I'll be like, you learn something. You're here to learn." [28 July 2026, 10 — Siddharth Saminathan]
